text.tspan: IN THE APP · React UI + Rayfin functions (app identity)
Validate: reads only, any failure ends the run as failed with an error.code
• mode is preview or restore; dry_run, restore_files are booleans
• target workspace / lakehouse are GUIDs; timestamp is 12 digits
• clean_target is blank, replace or all; all + filters is rejected
• archive address is valid and the container root can be listed
• manifest exists and says complete (else backup_incomplete)
• target lakehouse resolves via Fabric REST (lakehouse_not_found)
• restore mode + cleanup: confirm_target_name must equal the
Reads the manifest and looks at the target. A clash is a table (or a top-level
Files name) the backup would write that already exists there.
Cleanup plan (only if clean_target is set and the name matches)
clean_target_for_restore(dry_run = true) lists what would be deleted:
cleanup_plan, or cleanup_plan_error (for example a shortcut is in the way).
and the cleanup plan. The UI shows this as the preview.
Guards: nothing touched if one fails
First re-reads every table in the backup and compares it with the manifest.
Shortcuts are never deleted. Then DROP TABLE and delete each folder;
stops the whole restore if a folder cannot be deleted.
replace: only the tables (and top-level Files
names) that the backup puts back.
all: every table in the target, plus everything
under Files when Files are being restored.
Destination folders must be absent; Files names must not clash.
For each table: fastcp from the archive; version, file count and size must equal
the manifest; CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS; CREATE TABLE … USING DELTA
LOCATION; SELECT 1 proves it can be read.
The data stays in place and the table is
It needs a manual CREATE TABLE … LOCATION.
Files (if restore_files and the backup holds Files)
Each top-level item is copied (fastcp or cp). Nothing is overwritten.
Exit JSON, plus a copy at Files/rayfin_runs/nb_restore_run/<request_key>.json
Reading the result in the app
The UI polls getRun every 20 s. getRun reads
and the Runs panel labels the run Preview,
Dry run or Restore from that JSON.
